content: Yaka abwe Yosepa i sikal i na kin elana ge i ba, “Nam ge taliwau hi neem labi Kenani elana avaliyau wali sipi, wali bulumwakau ge wali bugubugul gegewena, heliya iyoho labi Gosen elana.”
Inoke abwe talinau ali toto nimala panuna i ahel ge i en tukagil kin manininaa.
Yaka kin i nel Yosepa talinau elal i ba, “Hauna wami tuwalali?” Anana hi lahe hi ba, “Tonowak! Ama wam totuwalali sipi ali tomatahikan, i ola valila tubumeyau hi giginol.

Ha nem ge naha minaa ga te panuwa ya elana sauga kekeisi, kaiwena galebu i bwata hot labi Kenani elana, inoke nige wama sipi aliya i gagan. He ha awanun elam ge nu talam ama wam totuwalali naha minaa labi Gosen elana.”
Inoke kin i baek Yosepa elana i ba, “Tamwam ge talimwau iyaka hi nem eliyam ge alomwau nuku mina,

inoke Itipita labena gegewena i mwapwela eliyam. Labi waiwaisana hot etega nu hile, yaka tamwam ge talimwau nihi minaa. He nihi minaa labi Gosen. Ebo gamwaliyaa enuna u atenal wali aatena i bwata, inoke nu telel no bulumwakau nihi matahikagil.”
Inoke abwe Yosepa i na tamana i en tukan kin manininaa, ge Yakobo kin ana ba awatauwan i baunan elana.
Yaka kin i nel elana i ba, “Wam baliman ana bwata ehila?”

Anana Yakobo i lahe i ba, “No galanawanawa panuwa ge panuwa ona elal yawaliu ana baliman ana bwata wan handeled ge teti (130). He no baliman nige hi gegewi ge pulowan hi gewi ya pwawal. Nam alona ge tubu wali galanawanawa panuwa ge panuwa ona elal yawaliliya ana baliman i bwata, yaa nau yawaliu ana baliman nige i bwabwata.”
Inoke kin ana ba awatauwan i baunan al elana ge i eguluwan.
Inoke Yosepa labi waiwaisana hot etega i hile Itipita gamwanaa panuwa Lamesese ana labiya, Gosen gamwanaa, yaka i pek tamana ge talinau elal ge hi minaa, i ola kin wana baaba.
He Yosepa tamana, talinau ge tamana ana heniheni gegewel aanan i pekpek elal, i golugoluwa natuliyau ali gewi elana.
Yosepa Itipita Bibilena Gegewena I Pwamola Kin kaiwena
Galebu iyaka i bwata nabi yaka nige al aanan i gagan labi gegewena elana, inoke panuwa Itipita ge Kenani galebu kaiwena hi wesal.
Gamagalau hi nemnem witi hi pwapwamola, inoke eliyana Yosepa Itipita ge Kenani wali mani gegewena i ahe, yaka i bugulan ge i na i pwahin kin wana gogomwau ana abateliya.

Sauga Itipita ge Kenani wali mani gegewena iyaka hi palian haba, inoke Itipita gegewel hi na Yosepa elana ge hi ba, “Wama mani gegewena iyaka ha pwamowasi. He aanan u guyauan eliyama ge naha an! Bahi naha aaligaa matamwa!”
Yaka analiya Yosepa i lahe i ba, “Ebo wami mani gegewena iyaka ku pwamowasi, he wami bwasumu nuku pwatanim eliyau, yaka molana aanan na pewa.”

Inoke wali bwasumu hosi, sipi ge goti, bulumwakau ge donki hi pwatanik Yosepa elana, yaka molana aanan i guyauan elal. He baliman o Yosepa i ginol ola to, yaka wali bwasumu gegewel hi pek elana aanan molana.

Yaka baliman etega al ana abatelipuna elana gamagalau hi na Yosepa elana ge hi ba, “Tonowak, nige bosowaina ama pulowan naha sume eliyam. Wama mani gegewena iyaka ha pwamowasi, ge wama bwasumu iyaka ha paliagil eliyam. Nige bugul etega i gagan eliyama tage naha pewa ge molana aanan nu pem, toto i minaa elama iyai te ama ge wama bilibili.

Bahi naha aaligaa matamwa ge wama bilibili ni mimibwagabwaga! He aloma ge wama bilibili naha paliagima eliyam, yaka molana aanan nu pem. Inoke ama naha tabwa kin wana totuwalali loloyowanil ge wama bilibili ni minek eliyana. He witi nu pem eliyama, yaka eliyana naha anana ge bahi naha aaliga. Ge pwatum nu pem naha luwan, yaka wama bilibili bahi ni tatabwa bilibili bwagabwaga.”
He galebu iyaka i bwata hot yaka Itipita gegewel wali bilibili hi paliagil Yosepa elana. Inoke Itipita bibilena gegewena i pwamola i tabwa kin wana bilibili.
Yaka Itipita ana labi gegewena gamagaliliyau hi tabwa kin wana totuwalali loloyowanil.
Yaa Itipita wali yabowaineyau ali topowon wali bilibili Yosepa nige i pwapwamola. Heliya nige wali bilibili hi papalian, kaiwena kin aanan i pekpek elal ge eliyana hi anana.
Yaka Yosepa i baek gamagalau elal i ba, “He lan ebe alomiu wami bilibili iyaka ya pwamolamiu kin kaiwena. He aanan vivena hiwe, ku ahe ge nuku na nuku luwan wami eyowaa.

Sauga ebo aanan ni matuwa ge nuku pahi, yaka pwahin nimala panuna nuku ginolil, ge maisena nuku pek kin kaiwena. Yaka pwahin esopali nuku kukuhikan, enuna wami vivi kaiwena, ge enuna aamiu, alomiyau natumiyau ge wami limi ana heniheni.”
Inoke gamagalau hi baek Yosepa elana hi ba, “Tonowak, owa u ginol bubun eliyama ge yawalima u pwamwal, he ha talam naha tabwa kin wana totuwalali loloyowanil.”

Inoke Yosepa logugui etega i ginol Itipita kaiweliya. Ebo wali eyowa enona ni matuwa ge nihi pahi, yaka pwahin nimala panuna nihi ginolil ge maisena nihi pek kin elana. He logugui o iyoho i gangan sauga ya elana. Iyai te topowon wali bilibili nige kin i aahe, inoke nige enona enuna hi pepek kin elana.
Yakobo I Ba Tuwana Nihi Teliek Tamana ge Tubuna wali Salaiya
Boda Isileli hi minaa labi Gosen elana panuwa Itipita, ge hi gogomwau hot. Inoke hi talaabab ge hi gewi nabi.
He Yakobo i minaa panuwa Itipita elana baliman ana gewi sebentin (17), inoke yawalina ana baliman ana bwata wan handeled ge poti seben (147).

Sauga amnana i anbose wana yaomal ana sauga iyaka i kelakelaubwa, inoke natuna Yosepa ana baaba i patuna ge i nem elana. Inoke i baek elana i ba, “Ebo u nunuwana-agau nabiyan, yaka nimwam u teliya nagiliu gabulanaa,
inoke nu bateli te nu awatauwagau ge nu ginol ni ola no baaba. He bahi tuwau nu teteliya Itipita.
Yaa sauga na yaomal, yaka tuwau nu kalivai egonan Itipita elana ge nu na nu teliya nam ge tubu wali salaiya.” Anana Yosepa i lahe i ba, “Na ginol ola toto u baunan eliyau.”

Inoke i baek Yosepa elana i ba, “Nu papasila eliyau te nasi nu ginol ola o.” Inoke Yosepa i papasila. Yaka abwe Isileli wana suki i ahe ge i gena palalek suki kokowanaa, yaka i tapwalolo Yehoba elana.

footnotes.text: Abatelipuna 24:2 ana epwamwananal paiya nu kite.
